entities.summary: Laura Jansen is a Dutch-American musician. Before gaining fame in the Netherlands, Jansen became a fixture in the constellation of artists associated with Los Angeles nightclub Hotel Café – a national launching pad for artists as Sara Bareilles, Priscilla Ahn and Joshua Radin. As a daughter of an American mother and Dutch father, Laura has been living in the United States for over 10 years. Laura Jansen was a composers & musicians from Breda (b. 1977-03-04, Breda). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
